title: Chickpea Fritters with Mediterranean Quench
description: A crispy and flavorful fritter recipe with the added zing of a Mediterranean quenched sauce. Perfect as a snack or light meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, mash chickpeas using a fork or potato masher.
Add flour, breadcrumbs, and garlic powder to the bowl. Mix well.
Heat olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop fritter mixture into the pan.
Flatten fritters slightly and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Transfer fritters to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Warm quenched sauce in a saucepan over low heat.
Serve fritters with a drizzle of warmed quenched sauce and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
